case_definition.note: PRIMARY analysis: reports matched on this single openFDA field (the narrow population). See population_sensitivity for the same analysis over the union of every spelling.

population_sensitivity.definition: union over every openFDA field AND every other name openFDA gives this product (its NDC-derived brand/generic/substance set). Known limit: only NDC-matched reports carry that name set, so an as-reported spelling that never mapped stays out of this cohort.
